page.overview:
Who is Banzai?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Banzai was introduced in 1993, as part of the Ninja Force subset of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: yellow hair; purple face mask with yellow sash; no shirt; purple and black diagonal strap; black gloves; black and purple spotted pants with black boots

Accessories: magenta "Slice" knife; two Y-shaped, magenta dueling knives; magenta "Dojo" sword; magenta "'92 Storm Shadow" sword; magenta "Dojo" sickle (without string or counterweight); magenta "Dice" battle axe; magenta figure stand. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/93/banzai.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/93/banzai.shtml Filecard]
